summary.zh: 用问答建立邮箱分拣所需的知识库
summary.en: Build the priority knowledge base that email sorting reads

description.zh: 一次只问一个问题，把你的角色、重要联系人和优先级问清楚，写成后续邮件分拣使用的知识库，并在保存前校验完整性。适合第一次启用邮件整理，或职责与优先级发生变化时使用，需要本地 Python 3 环境。
description.en: Interviews you one question at a time about your role, key contacts and priorities, then writes the knowledge base that email sorting relies on, validating it before saving. Run it once, or again when priorities change.
